entries.title: Psalms 6:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.>> O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

entries.title: Psalms 6:2
segments: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 6:3
segments: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?

entries.title: Psalms 6:4
segments: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness' sake.

entries.title: Psalms 6:5
segments: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?

entries.title: Psalms 6:6
segments: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

entries.title: Psalms 6:7
segments: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 6:8
segments: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

entries.title: Psalms 6:9
segments: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 6:10
segments: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.
